3fuji200p01.jpg.title: Atrium
3fuji200p01.jpg.description: Looking straight up inside 75 State Street. We used the parking garage underneath and I didn't expect it to be so beautiful.
3fuji200p01.jpg.alt: The glass-roofed atrium inside 75 State Street viewed from ground level looking upward.

3fuji200p02.jpg.title: Custom House
3fuji200p02.jpg.description: One of those buildings that immediately tells you where you are.
3fuji200p02.jpg.alt: Boston's Custom House Tower rising above surrounding historic buildings with American flags in the foreground.

3fuji200p03.jpg.title: Park Street
3fuji200p03.jpg.description: Last time I was here, I had to save a detective from a mobster.
3fuji200p03.jpg.alt: The Park Street subway entrance beside Boston Common with pedestrians entering and leaving the station.

3fuji200p04.jpg.title: Downtown Boston
3fuji200p04.jpg.description: A street that somehow felt both historic and modern at the same time.
3fuji200p04.jpg.alt: A narrow downtown Boston street lined with historic buildings and the Omni Parker House Hotel.

3fuji200p05.jpg.title: Old State House
3fuji200p05.jpg.description: This building is absolutely beautiful. I wondered what it was like to look down from the tower.
3fuji200p05.jpg.alt: The Old State House in Boston viewed from a low angle against a bright overcast sky.

3fuji200p13.jpg.title: Mayflower II
3fuji200p13.jpg.description: I've wanted to see this ship for years. It somehow looked even more impressive in person.
3fuji200p13.jpg.alt: The Mayflower II replica docked in Plymouth Harbor with its tall masts silhouetted against the evening sky.

3fuji200p14.jpg.description: It's smaller in person, but that doesn't make it any less important.
3fuji200p14.jpg.alt: Plymouth Rock engraved with the year 1620 beneath its protective monument.

3fuji200p07.jpg.title: Scituate Light
3fuji200p07.jpg.description: This lighthouse was beautiful, it makes sense that there were people taking bridal photos there.
3fuji200p07.jpg.alt: Scituate Lighthouse standing on Cedar Point with an American flag in the foreground at sunset.

3fuji200p08.jpg.title: Across the Harbor
3fuji200p08.jpg.description: The water was almost perfectly still, but it sure was windy.
3fuji200p08.jpg.alt: A calm harbor in Scituate with houses lining the opposite shore beneath a colorful evening sky.

3fuji200p09.jpg.title: Waterfront Property
3fuji200p09.jpg.description: I'd love to just sit here for hours and watch the water.
3fuji200p09.jpg.alt: A waterfront home overlooking a quiet harbor filled with sailboats in Old Orchard Beach.

3fuji200p10.jpg.title: Scituate Harbor
3fuji200p10.jpg.description: A different perspective on the lighthouse as we headed back.
3fuji200p10.jpg.alt: Scituate Lighthouse seen across calm water with sailboats in the foreground during sunset.
